Container.Name: ghstats

Branch.TagDescription: Stable. Follows the newest ghstats release, so Unraid offers each new release as a normal container update. Recommended.
Development build of the main branch. May include unreleased changes.

Container.Overview:
ghstats keeps your GitHub repository traffic history beyond GitHub's 14 day limit. It polls the GitHub API every hour and stores views, clones, referrers, popular paths, stars, forks, issues, pull requests and release downloads in a local SQLite database, with per-repository dashboards, a JSON API, and embeddable SVG badges and cards.
A GitHub token is required. GitHub's traffic API only works on repositories you can push to. Use a fine-grained token limited to your repositories with read-only "Administration" and "Metadata" permissions, or a classic token with the public_repo scope (full repo scope plus GHS_INCLUDE_PRIVATE=true for private repositories).
The container runs as UID 100. If it cannot write its database, run once: chown -R 100:101 /mnt/user/appdata/ghstats
The dashboard has no login. Do not expose it to the internet unless you only track public repositories, or put it behind an authenticating reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (ghstats.db). Must be writable by UID 100.

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: GitHub token. Fine-grained: Administration (read) and Metadata (read) on the repositories to track. Classic: public_repo, or repo for private repositories.

Config.Name: Include private repositories
Config.Description: Also collect private repositories the token can see. Keep the dashboard on your LAN if enabled.

Config.Name: Repository filter
Config.Description: Which repositories to collect, in GitHub search style. Examples: 'yourname/*', '!fork', 'yourname/* !fork !archived'. Empty collects every repository the token can access.

Config.Name: Public list filter
Config.Description: Which collected repositories appear on the dashboard pages and cards, e.g. 'stars:>=5 !fork'. Data for hidden repositories is still collected.

Config.Name: Sync schedule
Config.Description: Six-field cron schedule for pulling metrics. Default runs at minute 59 of every hour.

Config.Name: Default sort
Config.Description: Column the home page sorts by.

Config.Name: Disable version check
Config.Description: Stop ghstats from checking GitHub for a newer ghstats release.
